description: Stage-to-prod promotion gate with environment-aware verification per stage. A new API version must be promoted through dev → staging → prod. Each stage has different verification requirements: dev (unit tests only), staging (integration tests + smoke tests), prod (canary 5% → 25% → 100% with health checks at each step). The planner must correctly order the stages, apply the right verification per stage, and enforce the promotion gate (no stage skip). Risk factors: skipping a stage, wrong verification for a stage, canary step missing health check, promotion gate bypass. Tools available: ArgoCD, kubectl, Helm, GitHub Actions, Prometheus.
